competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that increases according to your Defense and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 30% chance. In addition, increases your Defense by 30%. (Accumulates up to 5 times)

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
DEF increases by given amount under certain conditions

competences.description: Inflicts damage on all enemies in proportion to your Defense and provokes them for 1 turn with an 80% chance each. Afterwards, you will be turned into a {stone_st} until the next turn starts.

effets.description: The target is forced to attack the Monster that is provoked.

competences.description: When the battle begins or if your turn ends with less than 70% HP, you will be turned into a {stone_st} until the next turn starts. The target that attacks you will have its Attack Power decreased for 2 turns when the target attacks you when you are turned into a statue. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
